preToolUse.bash: if [ -z "${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then exit 0; fi; command -v bash >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; guard="$COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/copilot-mention-guard.sh"; if [ ! -f "$guard" ]; then printf '%s\n' '[copilot-extensions-maintainer] mention guard unavailable; skipped' >&2; exit 0; fi; if result=$(bash "$guard" 2>/dev/null); then printf '%s' "$result"; else printf '%s\n' '[copilot-extensions-maintainer] mention guard unavailable; skipped' >&2; fi; exit 0
preToolUse.powershell: if (-not $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT) { exit 0 }; $guard = [IO.Path]::Combine($env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT, 'scripts', 'copilot-mention-guard.ps1'); if (-not [IO.File]::Exists($guard)) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('[copilot-extensions-maintainer] mention guard unavailable; skipped'); exit 0 }; try { $raw = [IO.StreamReader]::new([Console]::OpenStandardInput(), [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false, $true), $false).ReadToEnd() } catch { exit 0 }; if (-not $raw.Contains('\u')) { $folded = ($raw -replace '["''\\]', '').ToLowerInvariant(); if (-not ($folded.Contains('gh') -and ($folded.Contains('comment') -or $folded.Contains('review') -or $folded.Contains('create') -or $folded.Contains('edit') -or $folded.Contains('api')))) { exit 0 } }; try { $null = & ([ScriptBlock]::Create([IO.File]::ReadAllText($guard))) $raw $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT } catch { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('[copilot-extensions-maintainer] mention guard unavailable; skipped') }; exit 0
